text: ハーバー・シティは試合終盤、2-3とリードされている中で、プレスを強め、ボールを直接的に前線へ送る戦術に切り替えました。その結果、ボール保持率は約32％から41％に上がり、攻撃の機会を増やしています[#1884]。しかし、シーブルック・タウンは変わらず56％の保持率を保ち、広いサイドからの攻撃で優勢を維持しています[#1884]。ハーバー・シティの戦術変更はゴールを狙うための勝負手でした。

- Harbour City increased their pressing intensity from 0.6 to 0.78 and directness from 0.28 to 0.43 at 90+2' to chase the game [#1884].
- Harbour City's possession rose from 31.7% to 40.8% after the tactical change late in the match [#1884].
- Seabrook Town's opponent xG increased from 0.74 to 0.96 following Harbour City's tactical shift [#1884].
- Score at the tactical change was Harbour City 2, Seabrook Town 3, with Harbour City trying to equalize [#1884].
- In the last 10 minutes, Seabrook Town maintained 56.0% possession and created 3 shots, compared to Harbour City's 44.0% possession and no shots on target.

- Harbour City was trailing 2-3 late in the match and attempted a tactical change to chase the game by pressing higher up the pitch, increasing directness in their play, and raising their defensive line height, reflecting urgency to regain control [#1884].
- This shift increased their pressing intensity from 0.6 to 0.78, directness from 0.28 to 0.43, and line height from 0.62 to 0.74, resulting in increased possession from 31.7% to 40.8%, which aligns with their 4-2-3-1 formation designed for patient short passing but adapted now for a more vertical, aggressive approach [#1884].
- Seabrook Town, set up in a 3-4-3 formation favoring wide play and crossing, maintained higher possession (56%) and field tilt (61.9%) in the last 10 minutes, exploiting Harbour City's higher defensive line and pressing by producing several chances and a goal in the period [#1884].
- Thus, Harbour City's tactical change reflects an attempt to overload and disrupt Seabrook's wide crossing patterns by pressing more intensely and playing more direct, but Seabrook's style and formation enabled them to capitalize on turnover opportunities.
